name: Copernicus Interactive Climate Atlas
description: Successor to the IPCC WGI Interactive Atlas, showing observed trends and projected change for regions worldwide at 1.5 to 4 °C warming levels. Draws on ERA5, CMIP6, and CORDEX from the Climate Data Store. More technical than Probable Futures but authoritative.
embedNote: Site sends a frame-blocking header, so the preview opens in a new tab

Software Licensing.note: Builds on the open IPCC Atlas code lineage; the hosted app itself is not published

Data Licensing.note: Copernicus free and open data licence

Technical Accessibility.note: Web app with figure and data export; no embed

Data Standards.note: NetCDF and CSV from the Climate Data Store

Infrastructure.note: Hosted by ECMWF; underlying data are mirrored openly

Community Governance.note: EU programme governance with scientific partners
